capabilities: Import Flomo memos into vault notes incrementally
Download memo attachments into a configurable folder
Push notes or selected text to Flomo via token, webhook, or URL scheme
Generate Canvas and Moments overview files from imported memos
Extract a Flomo Bearer token through an embedded WebView login
disambiguation: Not a general note-taking plugin; it only moves content between a Flomo account and the vault.
extras: Desktop-only features rely on Electron webview and Node.js modules; Playwright and native modules are lazily loaded on desktop only, and mobile falls back to manual token entry or URL scheme. Push via Bearer token uses a reverse-engineered private API with a local 100-item daily limit; official webhook push is described as Pro-member. README notes experimental bidirectional links and merge-memos-by-date, plus WAF bypass via spoofed Chrome User-Agent.
intentEvidence: Enhanced fork from jia6y/flomo-to-obsidian with major improvements
problem: Flomo memos live outside the vault, so keeping them as Obsidian notes requires repeated manual export and import with no incremental updates.
